name: GA-06
label: Safe D

key_factors: Strong Democratic district lean (~D+25) plus a favorable national environment
Incumbent Lucy McBath running with a large financial edge ($676K on hand vs. $100)
Prediction markets price McBath at ~96% to win
Republican challenger Kevin Martin is minimally funded with no outside support
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to McBath: a heavily Democratic-leaning district, incumbency, a favorable environment, and an overwhelming fundraising advantage against a challenger with essentially no resources. Markets agree, pricing her near certain, so the forecast stays in Safe D territory with only a modest trim for residual uncertainty.
model.watch: A major late outside-spending intervention on behalf of the underfunded Republican challenger would be the main thing that could narrow this race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview: Lucy McBath, the Democratic incumbent, seeks another term in a district whose partisan lean strongly favors her party, and the national environment adds further cushion. She has raised nearly $900,000 and holds about $676,000 on hand, while Republican Kevin Martin has raised barely $10,000 with $100 remaining and no visible outside backing. No independent polls or expert ratings are available for this race, so the picture rests on fundamentals and money. Prediction markets give McBath roughly a 96% chance of winning. The forecast calls this Safe D, with a modest haircut to the raw fundamentals to account for the absence of polling and the usual uncertainty in low-information races.
